claims.text: Contraindicated with opioid analgesics or current opioid dependence (including methadone or buprenorphine maintenance),
claims.quote: 1. Patients receiving opioid analgesics. 2. Patients currently dependent on opioids, including those currently maintained on opiate agonists (e.g., methadone) or partial agonists (e.g., buprenorphine).

claims.text: opioid-dependent patients, including those treated for alcohol dependence, should be opioid-free (including tramadol) before starting: at least 7 to 10 days after short-acting opioids.
claims.quote: opioid-dependent patients, including those being treated for alcohol dependence, should be opioid-free (including tramadol) before starting naltrexone hydrochloride tablets treatment. An opioid-free interval of a minimum of 7 to 10 days is recommended for patients previously dependent on short-acting opioids.
